[[File:Team ACT GRT.png|250px|thumb|Team A.C.T. in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team]]]] '''Team A.C.T.''' (Japanese: '''チーム{{tt|ＦＬＢ|エフエルビー}}''' ''Team F.L.B.'') is a [[Rank (Mystery Dungeon)#Rescue Ranks|Gold Rank]] {{md|Team|rescue team}} in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team, Blue Rescue Team]], and their [[remake]], [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX]]. The team is led by an {{p|Alakazam}} with {{p|Charizard}} and {{p|Tyranitar}} as teammates. Many Pokémon look up to them, including {{OBP|Mudkip|Ginji's Rescue Team}} from [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team]]. Team A.C.T. is only named in ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]'' and [[Pokémon Super Mystery Dungeon]]. In Red and Blue Rescue Team, their remake, and the {{pkmn|manga}}, they are simply referred to as "Alakazam's team". ==In the games== ===History=== ====[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team|Red Rescue Team, Blue Rescue Team]] and [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX]]==== Team A.C.T. plays a role in the games as the team that is idolized by the {{pkmn2|hero}}'s {{md|partner Pokémon|partner}} and [[Pokémon Square]] onlookers. They are first seen when {{mdc|Shiftry|1}} refuses to rescue {{DL|List of Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team characters|Jumpluff}}'s friend due to an unsatisfactory reward; Alakazam tells him that he shouldn't turn down a Pokémon in need, and he grudgingly agrees to go. When Shiftry doesn't return for several days, the hero and partner are asked by Jumpluff to see if he actually carried out the rescue at [[Silent Chasm]]. They see that he did rescue the other Jumpluff, but in doing so, he accidentally split a thundercloud with his wind, awakening and infuriating {{DL|List of Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team characters|Zapdos}}. The [[Legendary Pokémon]] kidnaps Shiftry and dares the hero and partner to rescue him at [[Mt. Thunder]]. They consult Team A.C.T., who warn them that Zapdos is a very dangerous foe. The hero and partner are determined to rescue Shiftry regardless of the danger, so the team agrees to go with them, Alakazam advising that they prepare for a difficult fight. At Mt. Thunder, Zapdos is defeated before Team A.C.T. arrives at the summit; when it gets back up, Charizard challenges it, but Zapdos states that it is done fighting and agrees to give Shiftry back, praising the hero and partner's valor. Tyranitar praises them as well, but Alakazam suspects that the hero is no ordinary Pokémon. The partner affirms this by stating that the hero is actually a human, much to Charizard and Tyranitar's shock. When asked if he knows why the hero became a Pokémon, Alakazam claims to know nothing, but advises them to speak with {{mdc|Xatu|1}} at the [[Hill of the Ancients]]. However, as the hero, partner, and Shiftry leave the summit, Charizard calls out Alakazam for obviously knowing something, and he replies that what he knows about this is better left unspoken for now. Later, [[Team Meanies|Gengar]] publicly accuses the hero of being the human in the [[Ninetales legend]], claiming that the human is responsible for the natural disasters and must be destroyed to save the world, causing the residents of Pokémon Square to chase the hero and partner down. After that incident, Team A.C.T. participates in a town meeting, and while no one wants to accept it, it is agreed that the hero must be destroyed. The team approaches the hero and partner at [[Team Base|their base]] with the news, and although they seem to be preparing to fight, Alakazam instead tells the hero and partner to get away and uncover the truth. He warns them that Team A.C.T. will be among the rescue teams hunting them down the next day, and that there will be no mercy next time they meet. After the hero and partner get through [[Mt. Blaze]], they wonder if anyone else can make it through such a harsh dungeon, only to conclude that Team A.C.T. is more than up to the task, dashing their hopes for rest. Indeed, they are the only team to pursue them all the way through their harrowing journey across [[Lapis Cave]], Mt. Blaze, and [[Frosty Forest]], finally catching up to them at the summit of [[Mt. Freeze]]. Sincerely disappointed that the hero and partner haven't met {{DL|List of Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team characters|Ninetales}}, Team A.C.T. heavyheartedly prepares to destroy them. The hero and Alakazam briefly clash, but before the two teams can start a full-blown fight, Ninetales appears and orders Team A.C.T. to stop, stating that the hero and partner are its guests. Alakazam takes the chance to ask the burning question, and Ninetales conclusively states that the hero is ''not'' the human from the legend, nor is the human the actual cause of the natural disasters to begin with. The partner is visibly elated at this revelation, but angrily yells at Team A.C.T. for wrongfully chasing them down, prompting an awkward apology from Alakazam. However, the conversation is interrupted when an earthquake happens; Ninetales warns everyone present that {{p|Groudon}} is likely to awaken soon. Team A.C.T. volunteers to quell it, while the hero and partner return to Pokémon Square and clear their names. As many days pass with no word from Team A.C.T., everyone begins to worry for their safety, to the point where Shiftry calls numerous rescue teams with the hope of forming a special team to rescue them; {{p|Blastoise}} of Team Hydro, {{p|Octillery}} of Team Constrictor, and {{p|Golem}} of Team Rumblerock volunteer for the role. However, when they end up defeated and expelled from [[Magma Cavern]], everyone begins to panic, exacerbated by Gengar taunting them for facing hopeless odds. However, the hero and partner declare their intention to go to Magma Cavern and rescue Team A.C.T., the partner's speech of a rescuer's pride rousing everyone to action again. Within the depths of Magma Cavern, they find Charizard and Tyranitar, who have been defeated by Groudon. They mention that Alakazam is still fighting it, and the hero and partner rush ahead to save him. Further in, they find Alakazam, who warns them to stay back, as Groudon approaches from out of sight. The room is rocked by thunderous footsteps and then filled with a blinding light; after it dissipates, Alakazam is nowhere to be seen, presumably defeated. The hero and partner are left to fight Groudon themselves, and when the Continent Pokémon is finally defeated, all three members of Team A.C.T. reappear. Alakazam assures them that Groudon will be fine and will no longer present a problem, and they all leave the dungeon. Back at Pokémon Square, everyone congratulates the hero and partner for succeeding where all others failed, and Alakazam states that they have become a first-class rescue team. However, Xatu telepathically announces to everyone at the square that a falling star, the true cause of the natural disasters, is on a collision course with [[Pokémon world (Mystery Dungeon)|the planet]], threatening to destroy it. The only hope to save the world is to go high above the clouds and convince {{DL|List of Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team characters|Rayquaza}} to destroy the star; all three members of Team A.C.T. agree that the hero and partner are the only ones fit for the task. In order for them to be able to go to [[Sky Tower]] in the first place, Alakazam assists Xatu in creating the [[Teleport Gem]], and they receive additional help from a {{type|Ghost}} Pokémon, who stays hidden and runs off afterwards; Alakazam assumes that said Pokémon is simply bashful. After the falling star is destroyed, Alakazam celebrates with everyone else at the Hill of the Ancients, but is saddened when the hero has to return to the human world. After the hero chooses to remain in the Pokémon world, Snubbull finds [[Luminous Cave]] and unwittingly [[Evolution|evolves]] into {{mdc|Granbull|1}}. Alakazam explains the process and benefits of Evolution, as well as the fact that only one Pokémon can enter Luminous Cave at a time. After this, the three members of Team A.C.T. can be found at Pokémon Square. Charizard and Tyranitar are both seen between the [[Kecleon Shop]] and [[Whiscash Pond]], wondering about the possibility of higher ranks than Gold. Alakazam sits between Felicity Bank and Wigglytuff Club, and when spoken to, he mentions his role model: the legendary rescuer known as {{p|Lucario}}, whom the highest rank is named after. After the [[legendary birds]] are recruited, and [[Stormy Sea]] and [[Pitfall Valley]] have been cleared, Alakazam is seen between Felicity Bank and Whiscash Pond. When spoken to, he describes a weather anomaly out in the sea near [[Legendary Island]]: a whirlpool stretching to the sky in a massive tornado. This allows the player to speak to the legendary birds at the island, ultimately granting access to the [[Silver Trench]], where {{p|Lugia}} waits. The day after the player recruits {{p|Ho-Oh}} at [[Mt. Faraway]], Charizard is shown exploring a dungeon, having paired up with Team Hydro's Blastoise for a change of pace. When Blastoise begins to show his fatigue, Charizard ridicules his reputation as a rescuer, enraging him and encouraging him to prove himself. Blastoise launches his {{m|Hydro Pump}} in various directions to show his vigor, and Charizard cheers him on, causing Blastoise to realize that the Flame Pokémon was just trying to rouse his spirits, thanking him for it. However, the two hear a voice from somewhere, as {{p|Mewtwo|an unseen Pokémon}} declares itself to be the strongest in existence before unleashing its power on them. Some time later, the two Pokémon manage to trudge their way to Pokémon Square before they finally collapse, barely able to move from their crushing defeat. They warn everyone at the square, including the player, not to go to the dungeon they explored, for fear of facing the brutal opponent that defeated them. This grants the player access to the dungeon in question, [[Western Cave]]. ===={{pkmn|Super Mystery Dungeon}}==== Team A.C.T. joins the hero's team after [[Connection Orb|connecting]] with {{mdc|Whiscash|1}}. All are connected with Whiscash. ===Moves used=== ====[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team|Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team]]==== It is mentioned by {{mdc|Lombre|1}} during the team's first appearance that Charizard knows {{m|Flamethrower}}. Alakazam also knows {{m|Teleport}}, as he used this alongside Xatu's Teleport to create the Teleport Gem. They were sent by [[Team Meanies|Gengar]] to get Mudkip to safety from [[Ginji]], and believed the rumors that Ginji was a cursed human being from {{p|Ninetales}}. That was all cleared up when Ninetales showed up.
